note: Fit by research/fit_weather.py on 2014-2026 outdoor games (126 rain, 29 snow); each coefficient shrunk by max(0,1-1/t^2). Units: proe = pass-rate shift; sp/sr = engine efficiency tilt (YPA/3.84, YPC/2.4); fum = fumble-rate multiplier increment; fg = FG make logit shift; tot = points vs closing total. Wind is per 10 mph above 10; cold is full at 25F or below, zero at 32F.
